comment: Great class, very straightforward topic. Dr. Balash is always happy to help with any questions. Small amount of hw after every class and the labs could be tricky at times. I agree with the below comment that the class seemed a bit too easy for what it was. It was mostly learning C++ with a bit of software at the end.
Very great professor, easy to follow, and he's very knowledgable. Makes the class way too easy in my opinion, though, leading me to not get as much out of it as I would have liked.

HE'S AMAZING. Super organized (!!!), kind, caring, accessible (you literally can Slack him at 10pm and he'll still reply). He's also super patient and will explain everything to you until you actually understand. Take him at all cost. Best CS prof.

Best professor in the computer science department; if you can take any class with Dr. Balash, you will learn so much. He is always available to answer questions during his office hours. Also, he gives a practice exam, which literally has screenshots from the exams to ensure your success if you put some work in. Everyone agrees, best CMSC Prof!
